title: InferenceRequest.v1
description: A request into the Inference Gateway for an object. Carries the requested model class + the object's preference reference + an input HASH (never the raw prompt text, which may be sensitive). The gateway resolves the preference, selects a provider (ModelRouteDecision), executes, and writes a ModelInvocationReceipt. Secrets are refs only.

input_hash.description: sha256 of the input — NEVER the raw prompt text
